COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
1 0 .0 3 .2 0 2 1 BA1 No. 2311 of 2020
Hon 'b le R.C. Kh u lb e, J.
Mr. Abhishek Verm a, learned
counsel for the applicant.
Mr. V.S. Rathore, learned A.G.A.
for the State.
Accused- Ram Kishore, who is
in judicial custody in connection with
FI R no. 130 of 2020, under sections
147, 148, 452, 323, 325, 354, 504
and 506 I PC, registered at P.S.
Kunda, District Udham Singh Nagar
has sought his release on bail.
I t is argued by the learned
senior counsel that the accused has
falsely been im plicated in the
offence; he is languishing in jail since
08.10.2020; he has no criminal
history and; he is ready to furnish
the sureties.
Per contra learned State
Counsel opposed for bail.
I n the present m atter, accused
is languishing in jail since
08.10.2020. He is 62 years old. He
has no criminal history. The offence
is triable by the Magistrate.
Accordingly, without going into
the m erit of the case, it is a fit case
for bail at this stage.
The bail application is allowed
and the accused is directed to be
released on bail on his executing a
personal bond and furnishing two
sureties in the like am ount to the
satisfaction of the court concerned.

Pending application, if any,
stands disposed of.
Let a certified copy of this order
be supplied to the learned counsel
for the applicant within 48 hours, as
per rules.

( R.C. Kh u lb e, J.)
